routes.title: Pāṇḍava Exile
routes.summary: Forest wanderings of the Pāṇḍavas during the twelve-year exile.
routes.description: A simplified path through principal exile landscapes named in the Vana Parva — Kāmyaka and Dvaita — toward the year in disguise at Virāṭa.

routes.title: Kṛṣṇa's Journey
routes.summary: From Vraja and Mathurā to the ocean capital Dvārakā.
routes.description: Educational path linking Gokula–Vṛndāvana–Mathurā with Dvārakā after Kaṃsa's fall — a traditional narrative arc, not a surveyed itinerary.

routes.title: Arjuna's Digvijaya
routes.summary: Indicative northern–eastern arc of Arjuna's conquest circuit.
routes.description: A schematic digvijaya spine for Atlas visualization — Indraprastha outward toward Magadha and the Gaṅgā lands — not a complete itinerary of every campaign.

routes.title: Balarāma's Pilgrimage
routes.summary: Pilgrim path associated with Balarāma during the war.
routes.description: Traditional accounts have Balarāma leave the Kurukṣetra war for a tīrtha-yātrā along sacred rivers. This Atlas path is a respectful simplification for exploration.

routes.title: Ashvamedha Horse
routes.summary: Indicative circuit of the horse of Yudhiṣṭhira's Aśvamedha.
routes.description: A simplified educational path for the post-war Aśvamedha horse — Indraprastha outward through principal kingdoms named in tradition. Not a surveyed itinerary.
